svg.title: C07-M01-F3: Defence in depth layers
svg.desc: A stack of independent network defence layers from the perimeter firewall through segmentation, IDS/IPS, host firewalls, authentication and monitoring.
svg.text: perimeter firewall -> internal segmentation -> IDS/IPS at boundaries
-> host firewalls -> strong remote/mgmt auth -> monitoring (sees the rest)
attacker must defeat several independent layers; monitoring watches all
Figure C07-M01-F3. Independent layered controls contain compromise and feed monitoring
